title: Yoga Studio Franchise Opportunity
name: Surya Yoga, 22 Franchisees, Est'd in 2006, Petaling Jaya HQ
description: Surya Group is a Malaysian wellness company offering franchise opportunities through an integrated ecosystem spanning yoga, fitness, women's wellness, and professional education. - Operates multiple brands including Surya Yoga, Surya Fit, Surya Wellness, and Surya Academy, creating diversified and recurring revenue opportunities for franchise partners. - Surya Yoga offers beginner yoga, therapeutic yoga, hot herbal steam yoga, Yin yoga, Vinyasa, sound healing, women's meridian yoga, pregnancy and postnatal yoga, and private therapy sessions, catering to beginners, women, seniors, rehabilitation, stress management, and lifestyle wellness. - Surya Fit is a boutique fitness concept specializing in Megaformer training, mat Pilates, functional strength, and body transformation through low-impact, high-intensity workouts suitable for all age groups. - Surya Wellness focuses on preventive healthcare through herbal steam therapy, meridian therapy, infrared wellness, singing bowl healing, women's hormonal wellness, and recovery programmes, targeting the growing healthy ageing segment. - Surya Academy delivers internationally recognized instructor certification programmes including RYT200, RYT300, Prenatal Yoga, Yin Yoga, Women's Meridian Yoga, Chair Yoga, Yoga Wheel, Yoga Stick, Gong & Singing Bowl, and Megaformer Instructor Training, attracting students from Malaysia and neighbouring countries. - Franchisees benefit from multiple recurring revenue streams including monthly memberships, class packages, private sessions, wellness workshops, sound healing programmes, women's wellness services, certification courses, retail sales of wellness products, and corporate wellness programmes. - Additional revenue opportunities include employee wellness programmes, corporate yoga sessions, team-building workshops, and women's health seminars for business clients. - Led by a founder with over 30 years of teaching experience, an international master trainer who has conducted programmes across Malaysia, Singapore, China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Vietnam, Thailand, Korea, and Japan. - The founder has developed proprietary programmes including Women's Meridian Yoga and Herbal Steam Yoga and has built one of Malaysia's largest yoga teacher training ecosystems, supported by experienced international trainers specializing in rehabilitation, movement science, Yin Yoga, and Megaformer education. - The business differentiates itself through proprietary wellness programmes, integrated yoga, fitness and wellness services, a strong education division, founder-led expertise, multiple recurring revenue streams, and a community-focused membership model. - Franchise partners receive an established brand, proven operating systems, comprehensive instructor training, marketing support, operational guidance, educational resources, and ongoing business development support. - Positioned to capitalize on increasing demand for preventive healthcare, healthy ageing, women's wellness, professional wellness education, and integrated fitness solutions across Malaysia and Southeast Asia. - Holds valid SSM registration and offers a scalable franchise model for entrepreneurs, wellness professionals, and investors seeking entry into the growing wellness industry.
